note: Lifecycle rules per lane (Lopez de Prado's portfolio-oversight stages). Draft until Mikka signs; the board shows triggers as 'review' flags, never acts. Signing writes data/inferno_lifecycle_ack.json.

short-premium-v2.label: Short-premium iron flies (v2)
short-premium-v2.graduate: prereg CONFIRM: >=60 events, >=40 names, ex-two-best mean > +0.10R, clustered CI low > 0
short-premium-v2.scaleUp: after graduation: 20 operator-paper fills of the same structure before any capital
short-premium-v2.kill: prereg KILL, or the time-box without breadth

runner-A.label: Earnings Runner A (run-up)
runner-A.graduate: >=30 closed, ex-two-best mean > 0, clustered CI low > 0
runner-A.kill: >=30 closed and (ex-two-best mean <= 0 or CI high < 0), or the time-box

runner-B.label: Earnings Runner B (runner)
runner-B.graduate: >=30 closed, ex-two-best mean > 0, clustered CI low > 0
runner-B.kill: >=30 closed and (ex-two-best mean <= 0 or CI high < 0), or the time-box

runner-C.label: Earnings Runner C (your calls)
runner-C.graduate: >=30 closed, ex-two-best mean > 0, clustered CI low > 0
runner-C.kill: >=30 closed and (ex-two-best mean <= 0 or CI high < 0), or the time-box

operator-paper.label: Operator paper (promotion gate)
operator-paper.graduate: 30 qualified fills and the promotion gates
operator-paper.scaleUp: none while live options are paused (drawdown) and the account is under ~$10k
operator-paper.kill: not applicable: this is the evidence channel

capex-flow.label: Capex Flow conviction sleeve (shares)
capex-flow.graduate: already live by the signed plan (30% sleeve target)
capex-flow.scaleUp: keep the 30% target while the 91-day cohorts beat the equal-weight universe on average
capex-flow.cutBack: 91-day cohorts trail the universe by more than 5 points on average (>=2 matured): review cutting the target to 15%, the rest to core
capex-flow.kill: 182-day cohorts trail by more than 10 points on average (>=2 matured), or the capex tap turns to cut: review retiring the sleeve

long-term.label: Long-term lane (picks only)
long-term.graduate: 182-day cohorts beat the universe on average (>=3 matured)
long-term.scaleUp: candidate names for the conviction sleeve
long-term.kill: 182-day cohorts trail by more than 10 points on average (>=2 matured)
